seo.seo_title: About us, a student company from Boden | Norden Media UF
seo.seo_description: Norden Media UF is a local media agency in Boden run by three students at Björknäsgymnasiet. We build websites and live stream events for businesses and organisations.

page_header.t4: Norden Media UF is a media agency run by three students at Björknäsgymnasiet in Boden, as a student company in partnership with Ung Företagsamhet (Junior Achievement Sweden). We build websites and live stream events for businesses and organisations in Norrbotten. We are small enough to always answer ourselves, and curious enough to stay on top of what is new on the web.

hur_vi_tanker.t21: You tell us what you want. We handle the tech, from domain and email to hosting.
hur_vi_tanker.t23: A fixed price, and no invoice until you have approved the result.
hur_vi_tanker.t25: We explain things in plain language and tell you if something is not worth the money.
hur_vi_tanker.t27: We stay on after launch and develop the website as your business grows.

after_the_uf_year.t31: A UF student company runs for one school year, but working with us does not have to end there. Our plan is to continue the business as a limited company, with the same people and the same service, for every client who wants to stay.
after_the_uf_year.t32: The website and all its content belong to you.
after_the_uf_year.t33: If you would rather move on, we hand over all the material and help you move to another provider, so the switch is smooth.
